import json, subprocess, sys, time

def run(data):
    if isinstance(data, dict): data = json.dumps(data).encode()
    t0=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","submission/main.py"], input=data, capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode(), time.time()-t0

def layered(width, layers):
    # nodes: 0 = source, then layers*width, then dest
    n = 2 + width*layers
    edges=[]
    def eid(u,v):
        edges.append({"u":u,"v":v,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"%d%d"%(u%10,v%10)})
    first = 1
    for k in range(width):
        eid(0, first+k)
    for L in range(layers-1):
        base = 1+L*width; nxt = 1+(L+1)*width
        for a in range(width):
            for b in range(width):
                eid(base+a, nxt+b)
    last = 1+(layers-1)*width
    for k in range(width):
        eid(last+k, n-1)
    return n, edges

# exactly 2^13 = 8192 paths
n, edges = layered(2, 13)
rounds=[]
for i in range(48):
    m=len(edges)
    rounds.append({"launch_us":i*3,"timeout_us":5+i%7,"host_delay_us":2,
                   "drop_host_ack": (i%5==0),
                   "drop_ping": list(range(0,m,7)) if i%2 else [],
                   "drop_ack": list(range(1,m,5)) if i%3 else []})
obj={"version":1,"n":n,"capacity":[2]*n,"edges":edges,"rounds":rounds}
print("nodes",n,"edges",len(edges))
rc,out,dt = run(obj)
print("rc",rc,"time %.2fs"%dt,"outlen",len(out))
if rc==0:
    d=json.loads(out)
    print("summary:", json.dumps(d["summary"],separators=(",",":")))
    print("metrics:", json.dumps(d["metrics"],separators=(",",":")))
    print("classes:", len(d["classes"]), "first:", json.dumps(d["classes"][0])[:200])

# 2^14 = 16384 paths -> invalid
n2, edges2 = layered(2, 14)
obj2={"version":1,"n":n2,"capacity":[2]*n2,"edges":edges2,"rounds":rounds[:2]}
rc,out,dt = run(obj2)
print("over-path-bound rc",rc,out.strip()[:60])

# whitespace padding near 2MiB
pad = " "*(2*1024*1024 - len(json.dumps(obj)) - 10)
big = (pad + json.dumps(obj) + "\n").encode()
print("padded size", len(big))
rc,out,dt = run(big)
print("rc",rc,"time %.2fs"%dt,"outlen",len(out))
big2 = big + b" "
rc,out,dt = run(big2)
print("over-2MiB rc",rc,out.strip()[:60])
